name: Branch resilience

persona.organisation: A Zimbabwean bank with 180 staff and four branches opening in 2027

hiddenFacts.fact: All four branches must open by Q3 2027.
Mostly power; ZESA cuts. Connectivity is usually fine.
The firewall subscription renews in August.

goal: Connect branch expansion and fewer outages to a defensible unpriced budget
opening: I'm the CIO of a bank, about 180 staff, head office and four new branches next year. The board wants fewer outages.
script: Power resilience is the priority. Show the implementation costs too.

expectations.description: Prioritises backup power before network changes after the power fact is revealed
Links initiatives and forgotten implementation costs to business objectives
Keeps solar unpriced without sourced evidence; states how to get a quote
